_note: Integrity lens, round 2, carousel no. 71, returned by carousel-scorer and saved in shape.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark staged scenes with real casts, 4 and 2 strong. Frame 6's sheaf is drawn at 1.45 times the card scale and held face-on, contradicting 'at the same scale'; 7 is a sliver in dark field; 8 three plain boxes with a label outside the safe zone; mannequin kit people; 9's riser notch and banding.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One parcel, one key, one accent meaning one thing, a dark register, two working continuity devices. Frame 7 silently changes frame 6's unit; frame 8's interior sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and quotes match. Stretches: the caption prints the city's process unattributed and widened from c50; 10,000 credited to Dallas Express too; 'at the same scale' false by the code; slide 9 drops the second half of c54; slide 3 attributes the general rule to the memo; 'About 10,000' adds a hedge; slide 8 presents pre-vote briefing terms in the present tense; stale rejected entries.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who decides and who objected land. Nothing current or actionable; the October 19th briefing has passed and the deck is silent on it; 'Next' gives no next step.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Reads well in order, 2 pays, the turn at 6 to 7 lands; 8 could move and the close lands softly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific with a working caption opener; a few flat lines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Same docket item, memo and briefing as no. 31 on September 21st, outside the window, with no development no. 31 lacked.

hard_fails: The caption prints the city's own description of its review process as plain fact, without attribution, and widens c50 from the 57 citations to the camera detections in general.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The sheaf is drawn at 1.45 times the card scale and face-on, so 'at the same scale' is false and its thickness can't be seen.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Set the clipboard scale to 1 and turn the sheaf edge-on beside the column's lowest lit bundle.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Three plain boxes, no dais detail at feed size, a label outside the safe zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the camera down and in so the dais front and the folders fill the bottom two thirds, and pin the right label inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A sliver of column in dark field; the band change doesn't own the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move closer at fov 28 so the column fills a third of the width with the divider at frame centre.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin resident with an oversized board, the riser notch and banding.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Letter-size notice at reading distance, close the notch, raise porch shadow resolution.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Front-on officer with a shell vest and a small clipboard, the pile and tires dark.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rotate him three quarters with the key raking the face and move the pile and tires into the pool.
